entities.summary: Mohamed Elbeltagy is an Egyptian physician, professor at Al-Azhar University and Muslim Brotherhood politician. He was a Member of Parliament from 2005 to 2010 and 2011 to 2012, and a member of the constituent assembly of 2012. He currently serves as the general secretary of the Freedom and Justice Party.
